result.instructions: Tools for eyworks, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which nurseries are in our company, and what are their guids?"; "How many children are active at our Milton Keynes nursery this month?"; "Which rooms does our nursery have, and what is their capacity?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes eyworks data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run eyworks_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run eyworks_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run eyworks_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. eyworks_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: eyworks_list_companies
tools.title: List companies
tools.description: List the companies your eyworks API client can access, with their guids. Start here to find the company and nursery ids. eyworks Public API: GET /companies.

tools.name: eyworks_get_company
tools.title: Get a company
tools.description: Get one company: name, address, legal registration and contact details. eyworks Public API: GET /companies/{companyId}.

tools.name: eyworks_list_company_nurseries
tools.title: List a company's nurseries
tools.description: List the nurseries of one company that your client can access, with their guids, names and tags. eyworks Public API: GET /companies/{companyId}/nurseries.

tools.name: eyworks_get_nursery
tools.title: Get a nursery
tools.description: Get one nursery: address, contact, capacity, opening hours and tags. eyworks Public API: GET /nurseries/{nurseryId}.

tools.name: eyworks_list_rooms
tools.title: List a nursery's rooms
tools.description: List the rooms of one nursery with their capacity and age ranges. eyworks Public API: GET /nurseries/{nurseryId}/rooms.

tools.name: eyworks_list_employees
tools.title: List a nursery's employees
tools.description: List the employees of one nursery, with status, start and leave dates. Personal data: use only for the nursery's own purposes. eyworks Public API: GET /nurseries/{nurseryId}/employees.

genders.description: Configured gender names, for example female.

start_date_from.description: Start date on or after, yyyy-mm-dd.

start_date_to.description: Start date on or before, yyyy-mm-dd.

leave_date_from.description: Leave date on or after, yyyy-mm-dd.

leave_date_to.description: Leave date on or before, yyyy-mm-dd.

dob_from.description: Date of birth on or after, yyyy-mm-dd.

dob_to.description: Date of birth on or before, yyyy-mm-dd.

tools.name: eyworks_list_children
tools.title: List a nursery's children
tools.description: List the child records of one nursery, with status, start and leave dates and date of birth. Personal data about children: use only for the nursery's own purposes. eyworks Public API: GET /nurseries/{nurseryId}/children.

start_date_to.description: Start date on or before, yyyy-mm-dd.

leave_date_from.description: Leave date on or after, yyyy-mm-dd.

leave_date_to.description: Leave date on or before, yyyy-mm-dd.

dob_from.description: Date of birth on or after, yyyy-mm-dd.

dob_to.description: Date of birth on or before, yyyy-mm-dd.

tools.name: eyworks_get_availability
tools.title: Get nursery availability
tools.description: Get the availability of one nursery, as a nursery-level breakdown. Needs the availability:read scope. eyworks Public API: GET /nurseries/{nurseryId}/availability.
